what_was_measured: the four BiRWKV contexts at 4K/16K/32K/64K, status ok, before the grid aborted on an unrelated model's load failure
why_this_matters: the first measured throughput and peak memory for the model the paper is about, from an inference_mode run rather than the training-shape calibration. The analytic state figure is 20 MiB, matching the constant-state claim the manuscript makes.
the_policy_defect_it_exposed: the grid ABORTED on a load failure for a different model (llada-8b-base: 'LLaDAModelLM' object has no attribute 'all_tied_weights_keys', a transformers-version incompatibility rather than a missing loader). The abort cost the twenty cells the other five models would have produced, having already measured four. A load failure is a fact about the ARTIFACT and the other models' measurements do not depend on it, so it is now a `load_failed` ROW carrying the refusal text, and the grid continues. An IMPORT failure still aborts, because every cell after it would be meaningless -- the distinction the original policy wanted is real and was drawn one level too coarse.
still_open: llada-8b-base cannot be loaded under the installed transformers; that is now a recorded hole in the table rather than a reason to have no table
